scripts.postinstall: git submodule update --init --recursive && node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('quartz')) { require('child_process').execSync('npm install', {cwd: 'quartz', stdio: 'inherit'}); }" && node install-local-plugins.cjs
scripts.install-plugins: cd quartz && npx quartz plugin install --from-config && cd .. && node repair-plugin-builds.cjs
scripts.build: npm run convert && npm run prebuild && (npm run install-plugins || echo WARNING: one or more Quartz community plugins failed to install/build - see errors above. Continuing the build with the plugins that installed successfully.) && cd quartz && npx quartz build
scripts.preview: npm run convert && npm run prebuild && (npm run install-plugins || echo WARNING: one or more Quartz community plugins failed to install/build - see errors above. Continuing the build with the plugins that installed successfully.) && cd quartz && npx quartz build --serve
